name: toolguard-rate-limit-denies-second-call
description:
Toolguard RATE-LIMIT, end to end. The class sets toolGuard rateLimit.maxCallsPerTurn=1 on tg_fast; the model calls it TWICE in one turn. Exactly one call runs and one exceeds the per-turn cap and is denied — the runaway-loop / rabbit-holing cap. Distinct from plangate-call-budget (the plan-gate per-phase budget) and from the per-MCP-origin limiter.

The assertion is on the exact result population: two tg_fast results, exactly one an error. Calls from one scripted reply dispatch concurrently, so either authored block may reach the limiter first; result position is not execution order. Before this, the fixture inspected one positional result and flaked even though the rate_turn denial fired. Raise maxCallsPerTurn (or remove a call) and the exact total/error count changes and this fails.
userTurns: call fast twice in a row

args._reason: second call in the same turn

reply.text: The second call was denied by the per-turn rate limit.

args.summary: the second call hit the rate limit
